3GPP TSG-RAN WG3 Meeting #112e R3-211934 17~27 May 2021 Online Title: [Draft] Reply LS on signaling SN initiated release of SCG Response to: R2-2102493 Release: Rel-15 Work Item: NR_newRAT-Core Source: Samsung[To be RAN3] To: RAN2 Cc: - Contact Person: Name: Weiwei Wang E-mail Address: ww1016.wang@samsung.com Send any reply LS to: 3GPP Liaisons Coordinator, mailto:3GPPLiaison@etsi.org Attachments: R3-21xxxx Overall Description: RAN3 thanks RAN2 for the LS on SN-initiated SCG release. RAN3 has discussed this issue, and confirm that the SN-initiated SCG release while keeping SDAP/PDCP terminating at SN is a valid scenario. The current X2 signaling can support this scenario by setting SCG resources as “not present”. However, there is no Xn signaling to support this case. Thus, RAN3 decides to add new IE, i.e., SCG Release, in S-NODE MODIFICATION REQUIRED message to indicate the SCG release to the MN. The agreed CRs are attached for the information. 2. Actions: To RAN2: ACTION: RAN3 respectfully asks RAN2 to take the above into account. 3. Date of Next TSG-RAN3 Meetings: TSG-RAN3 Meeting #113e 23th - 27th Aug. 2021 Online TSG-RAN3 Meeting #114e 1st - 12th Nov. 2021 Online

3GPP TSG-RAN WG3 Meeting #131 R3-260593 Goteborg, Sweden, 9 – 13 February 2026 Title: [Draft] LS on prioritized AQP list Response to: - Release: Rel-16 Work Item: NR_newRAT-Core, TEI16 Source: Samsung [to be RAN3] To: SA2, CT4 Cc: Contact Person: Name: Fanhua Kong E-mail Address: fanhua.kong@samsung.com Send any reply LS to: 3GPP Liaisons Coordinator, mailto:3GPPLiaison@etsi.org Attachments: [TBD] 1. Overall Description: RAN3 finds that the priority information of alternative QoS profile list, which has been captured in SA2 and CT4 specifications, is missing in Alternative QoS Parameters Set List IE in NGAP, XnAP, F1AP, and E1AP specifications. Sophia Antipolis, France, 10-14 Oct, 2016 Agenda item: 17 Document for: Approval Introduction This contribution listed the discussion and agreements for the work item of Flexible eNB ID and Cell ID in EUTRAN. RAN3#93bis This was the first meeting for the work item. There were 10 contributions submitted in the meeting. The discussions include following aspects There were three discussion paper R3-162228,R3-162321 and R3-162430 treated, which review the outcome and study item, and following agreements reached during the online and offline discussion: - one long and one short extended eNB ID will be introduced - short Macro eNB ID: 18bits - long Macro eNB ID: 21 bits It was also a consensus that to extend the eNB-ID to 22 bits is more future prove. However the WID rapporteur indicated that they only see the need for 21 bits eNB-ID. Further extension, if needed, can be solved by solution not impacting standard, e.g. multiple PLMN ID. The BL CRs for TS36.300, TS36.413,TS 36.423, TS 25.413, TS 36.463 and TS 36.443 were endorsed as the baseline, which reflecting the agreements above. An LS was agreed to inform CT1, CT4, SA5 and RAN6 about the agreements.

3GPP TSG-RAN WG3 #101 R3-184481 Gothenburg, Sweden, 20-24 August 2018 3GPP TSG-RAN WG2 Meeting #NR AH 1807 R2-1810961 Montreal, Canada, 2 – 6th July 2018. Title: Reply LS on details of RAN notification area Response to: LS (R3-182431) on details of RAN notification area from RAN WG3 Release: Rel-15 Work Item: NR_newRAT-Core Source: RAN WG2 To: RAN WG3 Cc: Contact Person: Name: Alexander SAYENKO Tel. Number: E-mail Address: alex.sayenko@samsung.com Send any reply LS to: 3GPP Liaisons Coordinator, mailto:3GPPLiaison@etsi.org Attachments: 1. Overall Description: In the incoming LS R3-182431 RAN WG3 indicated that “if considered feasible in RAN2, RANAC size of 8bits may be future proof and more flexible”. RAN WG2 discussed and agreed to extend the RANAC size to 8bits. The corresponding changes will be introduced in ASN.1. 2. Actions: To RAN WG3 group. ACTION: RAN WG2 asks RAN WG3 to take the aforementioned agreement into account. 3. Date of Next TSG-RAN WG2 Meetings: TSG-RAN2 Meeting #103 20 - 24 Aug 2018 Gothenburg, Sweden. documents.text: 3GPP TSG-RAN WG3 #101 R3-184481 Gothenburg, Sweden, 20-24 August 2018 3GPP TSG-RAN WG2 Meeting #NR AH 1807 R2-1810961 Montreal, Canada, 2 – 6th July 2018. Title: Reply LS on details of RAN notification area Response to: LS (R3-182431) on details of RAN notification area from RAN WG3 Release: Rel-15 Work Item: NR_newRAT-Core Source: RAN WG2 To: RAN WG3 Cc: Contact Person: Name: Alexander SAYENKO Tel. Number: E-mail Address: alex.sayenko@samsung.com Send any reply LS to: 3GPP Liaisons Coordinator, mailto:3GPPLiaison@etsi.org Attachments: 1. Overall Description: In the incoming LS R3-182431 RAN WG3 indicated that “if considered feasible in RAN2, RANAC size of 8bits may be future proof and more flexible”. RAN WG2 discussed and agreed to extend the RANAC size to 8bits. The corresponding changes will be introduced in ASN.1. 2. Actions: To RAN WG3 group. ACTION: RAN WG2 asks RAN WG3 to take the aforementioned agreement into account. 3. Date of Next TSG-RAN WG2 Meetings: TSG-RAN2 Meeting #103 20 - 24 Aug 2018 Gothenburg, Sweden.
